collection.description: A child struggles to pronounce a visitor's name and fears being laughed at.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) struggles to pronounce a visitor's name and fears being laughed at.

choices.label: Ask the Visitor to Say It Slowly
Learn What the Visitor Prefers to Be Called
Turn Pronunciation into a Playful Exchange
Model a Respectful Apology for Mistakes

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (visitor) offers a friendly correction without requiring perfection.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (visitor) prefers their full name, and (child) keeps trying.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Both teach each other difficult words and laugh together.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The game stops when (visitor) grows tired of repeating their name.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) learns that correction is ordinary, not humiliating.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (adult) admits they have been mispronouncing the name too.
